errors.permission: You don't have permission to edit this.
errors.missing: This record is no longer available.
errors.session: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.csrf: Your session expired. Please refresh and try again.

generic.title: Couldn't complete that action
generic.body: Something went wrong and your change wasn't saved. Please refresh and try again.

permission.title: You don't have permission
permission.body: You're not allowed to make this change. Ask an admin if you think this is a mistake.

session.title: Your session expired
session.body: Please sign in again to continue.

csrf.title: Your session expired
csrf.body: Please refresh the page and try again.

noPipeline.title: No pipeline to convert into
noPipeline.body: Create a pipeline in Settings, then convert this lead again.

converted.title: This lead is already converted
converted.body: It already has a deal. Refresh the page to see the current state.

invalidFilter.title: One of these conditions isn't valid
invalidFilter.body: Check each condition's value: a number field needs a number, and a date field needs a date.

partialArchive.title: Some deals weren't archived
partialArchive.body: Deals you can't edit stayed in the list. The rest moved to the Archive tab.

partialStage.title: Some deals weren't moved
partialStage.body: Won, lost, and deals you can't edit kept their stage. The rest moved.

mailConnection.title: Mailbox unavailable
mailConnection.body: Check the mailbox connection and its current status in Settings.

mailInvalid.title: Mailbox settings need attention
mailInvalid.body: Reconnect the mailbox or ask your administrator to review its credentials.

mailSync.title: Mailbox sync paused
mailSync.body: Check the connection status and retry synchronization when the problem is resolved.

mailRejected.title: Message was not submitted
mailRejected.body: The mail server rejected this message. Review the recipients and connection settings before trying again.

mailUnknown.title: Send result is not confirmed
mailUnknown.body: The server may have accepted this message. Check its status before taking any further action.

mailUnsupported.title: Action unavailable for this mailbox
mailUnsupported.body: This mailbox does not support the requested action or does not grant the required access.

mailChanged.title: Mailbox connection changed
mailChanged.body: Refresh the mailbox to review its current connection before continuing.

mailWriteUnknown.title: Change is not yet confirmed
mailWriteUnknown.body: The mail server may have applied this change. Refresh the mailbox and confirm its state before trying again.

mailWritePartial.title: Some changes were confirmed
mailWritePartial.body: Other changes are still unconfirmed. Refresh the mailbox and review the remaining messages before continuing.

search.error: Couldn't run that search. Try again.
